A1.justification: Both PDFs describe GaussianCity and provide readable main text and Appendices A–B. Their equations, five tables and thirteen figures support a reliable comparison without identified material gaps.

before.justification: v2 reports original GoogleEarth and KITTI-360 generation results, a 20-volunteer user study, component ablations and additional demonstrations in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark results, user study, ablations and appendix demonstrations. Retention from v2 does not change their status as original empirical results.

M1.justification: Sections 3.2–3.5 retain the same BEV-Point initialization, visibility and density filtering, style lookup, serializer/transformer/MLP decoder, RGB-only output and hybrid training objective.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same GoogleEarth drone-view and KITTI-360 street-view coverage. The building interpolation and relighting demonstrations in Appendix B also remain unchanged; newly cited works introduce no additional evaluated datasets or tasks.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain SGAM, PersistentNature, SceneDreamer, InfiniCity and CityDreamer on GoogleEarth, and StyleGAN2 (labeled StyleGAN in Table 1), GSN, GIRAFFE and UrbanGIRAFFE on KITTI-360. Qualitative and user-study comparator membership is also unchanged.

E3.justification: Sections 4.2–4.4 retain the same metrics, 15K/5K generated-frame evaluations, 100-frame depth evaluation and 20-person rating procedure. Training budgets, hardware, crop sizes and runtime measurement conditions are unchanged.

E4.justification: Tables 2–5 and Appendix A retain the same visibility/density, decoder, serialization and generated-attribute ablations. Appendix B retains the same interpolation and relighting demonstrations, with no new robustness tests or supplementary analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions report runtime averaged over 100 iterations and average user-study ratings. Neither introduces training seed counts, repeated-training estimates, error bars, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All result entries in Tables 1–5, plotted findings and qualitative examples remain unchanged. For example, Table 1 reports GaussianCity FID values of 86.94 on GoogleEarth and 29.5 on KITTI-360, with 93 ms GoogleEarth runtime, in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations (1)–(18), including point selection and serialization, are unchanged. Equation (3) moves across a page boundary, but no mathematical reasoning, assumptions or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same novelty, compact-representation, spatial-decoding and generation-quality claims, including constant VRAM usage as scene size grows and the stated 60-fold speedup over CityDreamer.

C2.justification: The interpretations of baseline artifacts and ablation findings are unchanged. Section 4.6 and Appendices A.2/B.2 retain the Manhattan/hollow-structure limitation, RGB-only prediction and attribute-optimization instability discussion, and imperfect relighting shadows.

D1.justification: Section 4.3 retains the same hyperparameters, optimizers, training hardware, budget and preprocessing details. The project link, baseline availability statements and Appendix B.2 plugin instructions are also unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds citations to DynamicCity, 3DTopia-XL, Urban Architect and CityDreamer4D, while removing DreamBooth3D, ScanNet, 3D-FRONT and 3D-FUTURE. Introductory examples and indoor-scene citation placement change, but the broader positioning and novelty argument remain stable.

P1.justification: v3 slightly edits the Figure 2 caption, updates an author email and adds a funding grant identifier, alongside citation adjustments. The section order, narrative and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The Figure 2 caption is shortened, Tables 1–4 have small spacing/divider adjustments, and text and references locally reflow, including Equation (3) moving from page 4 to page 3. No figures or tables are added, removed or substantively redesigned.

improvement.justification: v3 refreshes background citations and makes limited editorial and formatting adjustments, while retaining the method, all experimental evidence, reproducibility details and limitations, including Appendices A–B. These changes do not materially alter the paper's clarity or scientific support.
